freeStart.title: Gather the key facts in one place.
freeStart.subtitle: You do not have to keep the whole situation in your head. Add only what you know now.

trustBoundary.heading: Nothing is saved or opened yet
trustBoundary.body: This summary is temporary. It is not saved and no case has been opened.

choose.heading: Start with the issue you need to solve.
choose.body: This public intake stays on the claims already in launch scope. Pick the lane that matches your situation first.

details.heading: Answer the guided intake.
details.body: We only need the core facts for the first pack shell: what happened, when it happened, who is involved, and what you want to recover.
details.counterpartyPlaceholder: Insurer, landlord, employer, hospital, driver, or other party
details.desiredOutcome: What do you want to recover?
details.summaryPlaceholder: Add the core facts you would want repeated consistently in a complaint, notice, or follow-up call.

preview.heading: Review your Free Start pack shell.
preview.body: This shell keeps the intake facts together before deeper guidance, evidence prompts, or staff escalation.

includes.summary: A structured intake summary you can reuse without rewriting the facts.
includes.timeline: A clean timeline anchor with the date, issue type, and responsible party.
includes.handoff: A consistent handoff point for membership, hotline follow-up, or later escalation.

completion.heading: Your intake is complete.
completion.body: Your temporary summary is ready. It has not been saved and no case has been opened.

high.label: High
high.body: Your intake shows a clear recovery path with a defined counterparty and a concrete outcome.

medium.label: Medium
medium.body: Your intake is usable, but the facts suggest document review before you escalate.

low.label: Low
low.body: Your intake looks closer to guidance-only follow-up or early routing support than a clear recovery path.

levels.high: Join Asistenca for a team review within 24 business hours.
levels.medium: Upgrade for document review before you send the first complaint or notice.
levels.low: Use the hotline for routing support and the clearest next step before you escalate.

membership.high: Join Asistenca for a team review

member.high: Continue in member claims for review
member.medium: Continue in member claims and request review

portal.high: Continue in the portal for review
portal.medium: Continue in the portal and request review

hotline.low: Call the hotline for next-step guidance

result.announcement: Your temporary Free Start result is ready.
result.heading: Your temporary result is ready.
result.body: Use this result to organize what you know and prepare the next step. Nothing has been saved and no case has been opened.
result.disclaimer: This result is general information, not legal advice or a decision about your claim.

preparation.note: This number only reflects how complete the information you entered is. It does not predict eligibility or an outcome.

levels.high: Your facts are organized for the review option shown below.
levels.medium: A document review can help you check the pack before sending a letter.
levels.low: A short guidance call can help you choose the clearest next step.

evidence.heading: Evidence checklist
evidence.summary: You marked {available} items as available. {required} items are important for this pack.

vehicle_photos.name: Photos of the vehicle damage
vehicle_photos.description: Include close views and the wider scene where possible.

vehicle_police_report.name: Police or incident report
vehicle_police_report.description: Keep the report or reference number if one exists.

vehicle_insurance_details.name: Insurance details
vehicle_insurance_details.description: Keep the policy, claim number, and insurer messages together.

vehicle_repair_estimate.name: Repair estimate
vehicle_repair_estimate.description: Use an estimate or invoice that shows the expected cost.

vehicle_registration.name: Vehicle registration
vehicle_registration.description: Keep a readable copy of the current registration.

vehicle_driver_license.name: Driver licence
vehicle_driver_license.description: Keep a readable copy for the driver involved.

property_photos.name: Photos of the property damage
property_photos.description: Capture each affected area before cleanup where possible.

property_ownership.name: Ownership or tenancy document
property_ownership.description: Use the record that connects you to the damaged property.

property_damage_report.name: Damage report
property_damage_report.description: Keep any building, emergency, or contractor report.

property_insurance_policy.name: Property insurance policy
property_insurance_policy.description: Keep the relevant policy pages and claim reference.

property_repair_quotes.name: Repair quotes
property_repair_quotes.description: Collect clear estimates for the work that is needed.

property_correspondence.name: Messages with the responsible party
property_correspondence.description: Keep relevant emails, letters, or message records.

injury_medical_records.name: Medical records
injury_medical_records.description: Keep treatment notes, discharge papers, and summaries.

injury_incident_report.name: Incident report
injury_incident_report.description: Keep the report that records when and how the injury happened.

injury_witness_statements.name: Witness details
injury_witness_statements.description: Keep names, contact details, and any written statements.

injury_expense_receipts.name: Expense receipts
injury_expense_receipts.description: Keep receipts for treatment, travel, and other related costs.

injury_photos.name: Relevant photographs
injury_photos.description: Keep dated photos of the scene or visible effects where appropriate.

injury_lost_income.name: Lost-income records
injury_lost_income.description: Keep employer or payment records that show missed income.

unknown.name: Supporting document
unknown.description: Keep a clear copy if it helps explain what happened or the loss.

letter.heading: Your draft letter
letter.helper: Review every detail before you use it. The draft remains temporary and is not sent or saved here.
letter.copyError: Copying was unavailable. Select the letter text and copy it manually.
letter.placeholders: Complete these placeholders before using the letter:

timeline.heading: Planning timeline
timeline.intro: These are planning ranges, not promised response or resolution dates.

ranges.unknown: Timing depends on the next step

evidence_collection.label: Gather the evidence
evidence_collection.description: Collect the records shown in the checklist and keep originals safe.

first_letter.label: Review and send the first letter
first_letter.description: Check the draft, complete every placeholder, and choose how to send it.

expected_response.label: Allow time for a response
expected_response.description: Keep proof of delivery and note any reply you receive.

insurer_assessment.label: Insurer assessment
insurer_assessment.description: Keep the assessment, questions, and any updated offer together.

damage_assessment.label: Damage assessment
damage_assessment.description: Record inspections, estimates, and changes to the repair scope.

medical_documentation.label: Update medical records
medical_documentation.description: Keep the treatment timeline and related costs up to date.

escalation_window.label: Review the next option
escalation_window.description: If the issue remains unresolved, use the available support route to review what comes next.

vehicle.label: Track repair or payment progress
vehicle.description: Keep written confirmation of the agreed repair, payment, or next action.

property.label: Track repair or payment progress
property.description: Keep written confirmation of the agreed works, payment, or next action.

injury.label: Track treatment and response progress
injury.description: Keep written confirmation of decisions, payments, and remaining steps.

unknown.label: Planning step
unknown.description: Keep the relevant record and confirm what needs to happen next.

support.heading: Keep the first step clean and consistent.
support.body: The shell is designed to keep your first public intake short, repeatable, and ready for the next trust surfaces without reopening the facts.

points.lane: You choose the right commercial lane first: vehicle, property, or injury.
points.facts: The intake captures only the core facts needed to move forward clearly.
points.handoff: The same facts can flow into membership or follow-up without a routing change.

placeholder.heading: Choose a claim type to see the strongest evidence for the first pack.
placeholder.body: Free Start stays lightweight, but the right photos, reports, and cost proof make the later review faster.

vehicle.heading: Vehicle claims move faster with scene, insurer, and repair proof.
vehicle.body: Gather the basics before you ask for review so the pack can show what happened, who is involved, and what the loss looks like.

items.first: Photos of the vehicle damage and the wider scene.
items.second: Police note, insurer claim number, or incident report if one exists.
items.third: Repair estimate, tow invoice, or payout message that shows the amount in dispute.

property.heading: Property claims need damage records, ownership context, and repair costs.
property.body: Capture the condition before cleanup and keep the papers that show who is responsible for the building or policy.

items.first: Photos or video of every damaged room before cleanup.
items.second: Lease, ownership, insurer, or building-manager details tied to the damaged address.
items.third: Repair estimate, contractor note, or receipts for urgent mitigation costs.

injury.heading: Injury claims need treatment records, incident facts, and loss evidence.
injury.body: Keep the medical timeline and the incident facts aligned so later review can see both the harm and the recovery path.

items.first: Medical notes, discharge papers, or treatment summaries.
items.second: Incident report, witness details, or photos that show how the injury happened.
items.third: Receipts, wage-loss proof, or other documents that show the financial impact.

privacy.heading: Gather first, share later.
privacy.body: You do not need to upload documents in Free Start. Start with the minimum facts, and share evidence later only if you want a team review through membership or hotline follow-up.

triage.heading: Membership starts the review clock.
triage.body: Asistenca members receive a response from the team within 24 business hours after a complete claim pack arrives. If something is missing, we ask for it within the same window. Free Start stays informational, and the hotline stays routing-only.

validation.chooseCategory: Choose vehicle, property, or injury before continuing.
validation.completeIntake: Complete each guided intake field before previewing your Free Start pack.
